Composition & Indication

Clarithromycin 500mg — 14 Tablets (Generic for Biaxin®) contains Clarithromycin 500 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 14 Tablets at the official 500mg strength. The standard indication is the management of bacterial respiratory and skin infections, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Clarithromycin 500mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
